# Design system

Tokens in sets, themes that stack sets, component variants and their cells, mixins. Every write passes the AA contrast gate in every theme on the batch's end state.

## designSystem.setToken

Write one token ({ set, path, type, value }), under the AA contrast gate and the token group rules. A dimension token (a `type.*.fontSize`, a space step, a radius) may be fluid: its value may be a `clamp()`, `calc()`, `min()` or `max()`, such as `clamp(2.125rem, 1.2rem + 3.9vw, 6.4rem)`. A fluid size suits pages on a breakpoint frame; on a page whose frame scales (`responsiveMode: "scale"`) the canvas already scales, so a `vw` size there scales twice. To scale spacing, write a scale factor instead of every step: a `number` token named `scale` in a space group multiplies every dimension of that group and its subgroups (`space.section-y.scale: 0.75` makes every section spacing 25 % tighter, `space.scale` scales all spacing; above 0).

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `set` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `path` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `type` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `value` | any | yes |
| `description` | string |  |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"set":"core","path":"radius.md","type":"dimension","value":"9px"}
```

> A path that does not exist is created as a new token. Check the path in the `design-system` resource first; add tokens only on purpose.

## designSystem.setTokens

Write many tokens as one change, gated once for AA contrast on the end state, so one undo restores the lot. A dimension token (a `type.*.fontSize`, a space step, a radius) may be fluid: its value may be a `clamp()`, `calc()`, `min()` or `max()`, such as `clamp(2.125rem, 1.2rem + 3.9vw, 6.4rem)`. A fluid size suits pages on a breakpoint frame; on a page whose frame scales (`responsiveMode: "scale"`) the canvas already scales, so a `vw` size there scales twice. To scale spacing, write a scale factor instead of every step: a `number` token named `scale` in a space group multiplies every dimension of that group and its subgroups (`space.section-y.scale: 0.75` makes every section spacing 25 % tighter, `space.scale` scales all spacing; above 0).

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `writes` | ({ layer?: "site" \| "blueprint", set: string (min 1), path: string (min 1), type: string (min 1), value: any, description?: string })[] | yes |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"writes":[{"set":"core","path":"color.palette.neutral.900","type":"color","value":"#4a4a4a"},{"set":"semantic-dark","path":"color.text.faint","type":"color","value":"rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)"}]}
```

> The contrast gate reads the end state of the whole batch: change a palette step and the role that sits on it together.

> The answer is the change: `changes` (the overrides added, changed or removed), `errors`, at most 20 `warnings` about what changed, and `warningCount` / `warningsByReason` for the whole system. A dry run says `dryRun: true`.

## designSystem.setComponentCell

Set cells of one design-system component in one save: each `{ cell, value }`, the cell key `<variant>.<size>.<state>.<part>.<breakpoint>.<property>` (`primary.all.hover.container.base.background`: `all` when the value does not vary by size, `base` or a breakpoint id). A value is a token alias such as `{color.bg.accent}` (a semantic or foundation token, never a palette step or a raw literal), a bare keyword for a property whose values are modes (a link underline's `none`, `always`, `hover`), or `{ component, variant }` for a part that embeds another component. Read the cell keys of a component with the `component/<key>` resource (designSystem.readComponent) and the segments with designSystem.read `components: true`. The menu dialog's drawer is the `drawer-nav` component: its `overlay` cells (`background`, `opacity`, `blur`), `panel` cells (`background`, `width`, `padding`, `shadow`, `z`, `radius`, `offset-x`, `offset-y`, `fit`) and `motion` cells (`delay`, `duration`, `easing`, `fade`) style it, such as `full.all.default.overlay.base.blur`. Every save runs the AA contrast gate.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `component` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `cells` | ({ cell: string (min 1), value: string (min 1) \| { component: string (min 1), variant: string (min 1) } })[] | yes |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"component":"button","cells":[{"cell":"primary.all.hover.container.base.background","value":"{color.bg.accent-strong}"}]}
```

## designSystem.createVariant

Add a variant to a design-system component, such as a light or a small button, a pill tag or a dark card: `variant` (its key, kebab case), `label`, and `from`, the variant whose cells it copies as the same aliases, so the new one follows the system until one of its cells changes. Change its cells with setComponentCell and draw it on a node with tree.commit `set_variant` { id, variant }. Under the AA contrast gate.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `component` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `variant` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `label` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `from` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"component":"button","variant":"ghost","label":"Ghost","from":"primary"}
```

## designSystem.createTheme

Add a theme ({ key, label, sets in precedence order, activation? }) as a draft, under the AA contrast gate: the previews show it, and a publish ships it only where a node names it (node theme, an instance's $theme, a data-theme attribute; the publish answer lists it in `draftThemes`). A draft's activation rule never applies on the public site: clear the draft flag with updateTheme to make the theme live by its rule.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| `sets` | string (min 1)[] | yes |
| `activation` | object |  |


## designSystem.resetToBlueprint

Remove site overrides so the blueprint's values apply again, in one revision. `scope` names what: `{ kind: "all" }`, one `token` ({ set, path }), every token under a path `prefix`, a `component`, some `cells` of a component, a `variant`, a `theme`, a site `set`, or `many` of these. A token the site added is deleted, which is refused (409) while a cell still aliases it.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `scope` | { kind: "all" } \| { kind: "token", set: string (min 1), path: string (min 1) } \| { kind: "prefix", prefix: string (min 1) } \| { kind: "component", component: string (min 1) } \| { kind: "cells", component: string (min 1), cells: string (min 1)[] } \| { kind: "variant", component: string (min 1), variant: string (min 1) }… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"scope":{"kind":"prefix","prefix":"color.brand"}}
```

> Destructive: ask the user before running it, and say what scope it resets.

## designSystem.importTokens

Import tokens from DTCG files in the Tokens Studio layout (one file per set plus `$themes`, loose or zipped as base64) or from a Figma variables export (collections become sets, modes themes); `mapping` renames imported paths to existing ones. Run it as a dry run first: the answer's `report` lists the adds, the changes, the type conflicts and the unknown names, and nothing is written. A confirmed import lands as one revision under the AA contrast gate.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `format` | "dtcg" \| "figma" | yes |
| `files` | ({ name: string (min 1), text: string } \| { name: string (min 1), base64: string (min 1) })[] | yes |
| `mapping` | Record<string, string (min 1)> |  |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"format":"dtcg","files":[{"name":"tokens.json","text":"{\"color\":{\"brand\":{\"$type\":\"color\",\"$value\":\"#1e3d4f\"}}}"}]}
```

## designSystem.diff

Read every override the draft holds over its blueprint (tokens, cells, variants, themes, sets, mixins). Over MCP it answers a summary (their count and names, the stylesheet's size); pass `full: true` for every override with its blueprint and site values, and the stylesheet.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `full` | boolean |  |

Example input:

```json
{}
```

> Over MCP it answers a summary: `overrideCount` and the first 100 `overrides`, with the findings counts. `full: true` gives everything; avoid it.

## designSystem.lint

Check the draft design system: every contrast pair below AA or AAA, the pairs that cannot be judged, the missing media assets and the lint rules' findings, with the draft's overrides. Over MCP it answers a summary (counts by severity and reason, the worst findings first, the override names, the stylesheet's size); pass `full: true` for every finding, every override and the stylesheet.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `layer` | "site" \| "blueprint" |  |
| `full` | boolean |  |

```json
{}
```

> Over MCP it answers a summary: counts by severity and reason, the `worst` 20 findings, the override names, the stylesheet's size. `full: true` gives everything; avoid it.

## designSystem.updateTheme

Edit a theme: its label, its sets in precedence order, its activation rule, `isDefault` (the former default stops being it; a default takes no rule and is never a draft) or `draft`. `draft: false` makes the theme live: published wherever its rule applies or a node names it. A draft theme is published only where a node names it.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

## designSystem.read

Read the draft design system's index: its revision, sets, themes, every component with its variant keys, and every token group with its number of paths. Ask for more with `tokens` (the groups whose paths and values to include, such as ["color.palette", "space"]), `components: true` (each component's sizes, states and parts, the segments of a setComponentCell key), `css: true` (the compiled stylesheet, about 240 KB on a large site) or `embeds: true`. The default answer stays small; read one component's cells with designSystem.readComponent.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `index` | boolean |  |
| `tokens` | string (min 1)[] (≤32) |  |
| `components` | boolean |  |
| `css` | boolean |  |
| `embeds` | boolean |  |

Output: { revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, detached?: { component: string, count: integer ≥0 }[], sets?: { key: string, label: string, position: integer ≥-9007199254740991, siteAdded: boolean }[], themes?: ({ key: string, label: string, sets: string[], isDefault?: boolean, draft?: boolean, activation?: { prefersColorSchem… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"tokens":["color.palette"]}
```

> Small by default: an index of sets, themes, component variant keys and token group sizes. Ask for one group's values with `tokens` (`design-system?tokens=space`); `css: true` only when you need the stylesheet.

## designSystem.readComponent

Read the cells of one design-system component, filtered and paged: `variant`, `size`, `state`, `part`, `breakpoint` and `property` keep the cells whose key segment equals them (a cell key is `<variant>.<size>.<state>.<part>.<breakpoint>.<property>`), and `own: true` keeps only the cells set at their own key, leaving out the inherited ones. Each cell has its own value (null when it inherits), the key it inherits from and the blueprint's value; `resolved: true` adds its value in every theme, `css: true` the blueprint's baseline stylesheet. `limit` cells (100 by default) from `cursor`; `total` counts every match and `nextCursor` names the next page. A large component has thousands of cells: filter by variant and state first.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `component` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `variant` | string (min 1) |  |
| `size` | string (min 1) |  |
| `state` | string (min 1) |  |
| `part` | string (min 1) |  |
| `breakpoint` | string (min 1) |  |
| `property` | string (min 1) |  |
| `own` | boolean |  |
| `resolved` | boolean |  |
| `css` | boolean |  |
| `limit` | integer ≥1 ≤1000 |  |
| `cursor` | integer ≥0 |  |

Output: { revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, component: string, total: integer ≥0, nextCursor: integer ≥0 \| null, cells: ({ cell: string, value: string (min 1) \| { component: …, variant: … } \| null, source: { cell: string, inheritedFromDefault: boolean }, blueprint: string (min 1) \| { component: …, variant: … } \| null, reso… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"component":"button","variant":"primary","state":"hover","own":true}
```

> Filter before reading: `variant` and `state` first, `own: true` for the cells actually set. Page with `cursor` while `nextCursor` is set; `total` says how many match.
